segments.text:
V. 19.
The deſire of other things choke the word—A deep and important Truth! The Deſire of any Thing, otherwiſe that is it leads to Happineſs in GOD, directly tends to Barrenneſs of Soul. Entering in—Where they were not before. Let him therefore who has received and retained the Word, ſee that no other Deſire then enter in, ſuch as perhaps till then he never knew. It becometh unfruitful— After the Fruit had grown almoſt to Perfection.
